description: Turn plain text into styled Unicode text (bold, italic, script, fraktur, double-struck, monospace, small caps, circled, squared, fullwidth, strikethrough, underline) that can be pasted into an Instagram or TikTok bio or caption. Returns every style, or one if you name it. Letters and digits only are restyled; a few styles may not display in every app.

style.description: Optional: one style only. Default: all styles.
